req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject non-string titles with an HTTP 422 response. This test suite includes a positive test to ensure valid string titles are accepted, a negative test to verify non-string titles are rejected, and a boundary test to check the behavior with an empty string title.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid string title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Valid Task Title", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task Title"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_non_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a non-string title (integer).
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title must be a string.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": 123, "description": "A task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "value is not a valid string" in response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"]

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_string_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty string title.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title must not be empty.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "ensure this value has at least 1 characters" in response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"]
